svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 15 — Panel 4: Wren+Luma at the temporal drive — diagnostic crouch
svg.desc: 2-shot 35mm, low-medium angle. Wren copper-suit (left) crouched on heels, sleeves pushed up, hand inside open temporal drive panel. Luma sapphire-suit (right) sitting cross-legged with sapphire holographic wireframe of the temporal drive hovering off her wrist. Drive housing between them — broken seam, internal crystal SHATTERED into 4 pieces glowing cyan. WREN: "Drive's a casualty." LUMA: "I knew. I just... wanted to confirm before I told Sable." WREN (quiet): "Not your fault."
